top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as AI Jitters Hit Tech Stocks
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index tumbled Friday, capping its first back-to-back weekly loss since late March as it was dragged down by the oil-price spike and a selloff in the tech stocks that once surged on the back of the AI investment boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
